title: NGAP,GTP: map IMSI to TEID and add Associate IMSI to GTP-U
description:
IMSI is known by HTTP2 stream, NGAP knows GTP-TEID. With this we can add
the information into GTP, so when GTP-U payload with matching TEID is
found Associate IMSI will be added.

This require GTP session tracking to be enabled

IMSI is known by HTTP2 stream, NGAP knows GTP-TEID. With this we can add
the information into GTP, so when GTP-U payload with matching TEID is
found Associate IMSI will be added.
